label: V1.7.18 — Trade-process: more permissive trade_id parser + pendingTrades fallback; commish-only Trade DM ON/OFF toggle in banner
description: First published version of the Draft Hub analytics model. This establishes the V1 baseline. Future tweaks bump the version and are logged here.

methodology_signature.weekly_grading: z = (score - p50_rostered_starter) / (p80 - p50); Elite z>=1.0, Plus 0.25<=z<1.0, Neutral -0.5<=z<0.25, Dud z<-0.5
methodology_signature.baseline_source: Rostered starters (weeklyresults.status='starter') joined with player_weeklyscoringresults; authoritative for pre-2020 and post-2020 alike
methodology_signature.games_played_gate: No Injury-Bust tier; small-sample rookies ride the raw NET classification. gp_3yr_total surfaces for context.
methodology_signature.draft_rating: per-pick Δ = actual 3yr NET − slot-expected 3yr NET (median at that round+slot); per-owner avg then shrunk via Bayesian prior (0-mean, 20-pick pseudo-count); scaled 0-100 anchored to league distribution
methodology_signature.pick_ownership: owner_name resolved by (season, franchise_id) → franchises table → transactions_adddrop → transactions_auction → team_name normalized lookup; legacy JSON owner field is last-resort (known mis-attribution risk)
methodology_signature.future_pick_projection: ordinal rank from 10yr reg-season AP% (owner-tracked, new-owner sample clipped) + bracket-aware playoff-Δ adjustment (bed-shitter/rally in top-6, tanker/try-hard in bot-6); brackets sealed; FINISH_TO_SLOT mapping 7→1.01, 8→1.02, 9→1.03, 10→1.04, 11→1.05, 12→1.06, 6→1.07, 5→1.08, 4→1.09, 3→1.10, 2→1.11, 1→1.12
methodology_signature.idp_window: R6 is IDP-only random drawing (May 2, 2026 6pm ET); not projected
methodology_signature.contract_parsing: MFL contractStatus='TAG' override rejected; authoritative tag = literal 'Tag' chunk in contractInfo pipe-string; 'No Further Extensions' parsed as walk-year marker

changes.summary: Two changes. (1) Fix: trade_id extraction in /api/trade/process now tries 6 regex patterns covering XML attrs / JSON / various MFL response shapes, AND falls back to fetching pendingTrades and matching the freshest sender→receiver offer when none of the regexes match. (2) Feature: commish-only 'Trade DM: ON/OFF' button in the banner — when OFF, Process Trade still goes through to MFL but skips the live Discord post.
details: Worker /api/trade/process: regex patterns expanded to cover <trade id=...>, <tradeProposal tradeId=...>, generic id=... XML attr forms.

Worker /api/trade/process: pendingTrades fallback after a successful propose — fetches the receiver's pending offers, matches by sender+offeredTo+asset equivalence, takes the freshest by timestamp. Same logic that powers v1.7.17 duplicate recovery, just used as a positive lookup here.
Frontend: STATE.silenceTradeAnnouncements (localStorage rdh_silence_trade_announce) drives a #trade-discord-toggle button visible only to commish.
Frontend: trade payload now includes silence_discord:true when toggle is OFF and we're in LIVE mode.
Worker /api/trade/process honors silence_discord — skips Discord post, returns {discord_posted:false, silenced:true}.
Frontend toast/result inline shows 🔕 Discord muted (per your toggle) when applied.

changes.summary: Trade-process now recovers from MFL's 'Duplicate trade offer' error by fetching pendingTrades, matching the existing pending proposal (same from/to + assets), and going straight to ACCEPT. Common case: a previous attempt got blocked by Commish Lockout AFTER the propose step succeeded — leaving an orphaned pending offer that blocks future retries.
details: /api/trade/process: on propose-fail with /duplicate/ in MFL response, fetch ?TYPE=pendingTrades&FRANCHISE_ID=<toFid>, match by sender + offeredTo + asset equivalence (normalized comma-sorted), grab the existing trade_id, skip to accept step.
Response includes `recovered_from_duplicate: true` so the frontend can flag it in the success toast.

If pendingTrades lookup yields no match (e.g. asset list differs), fall through to the existing error path with a clearer hint pointing the commish to Commissioner → Trades → Pending Trades to clean up manually.

changes.summary: Pick clock now survives a page refresh in LIVE mode. Two bugs fixed: (1) activePickStartedAt was only in memory — gone on refresh, so the clock would reset to a fresh 10:00 every reload. (2) When the live-state poller passed an authoritative MFL pick timestamp, the helper bailed if the slot key hadn't changed — so the bootstrap's Date.now() stamp would never get corrected.
details: Persistence: activePickStartedAt + activePickClockKey persisted to sessionStorage on every change, restored on STATE init. Refresh keeps the same countdown.
Authoritative-timestamp wins: when _pickClockEnsureStarted is called with opts.startedAtMs (the poller), it now ALWAYS prefers that value — corrects stale Date.now() stamps from the bootstrap.

Trade auto-refresh: after a successful commish Process Trade in LIVE, immediately fire _refreshLiveDraftState so the clock resets to the new on-clock owner's full time instead of waiting for the 20s poll.
Net result: refresh in LIVE = clock keeps running. Pick or trade = clock resets. Open clock from cold = stamps now until poller corrects with MFL timestamp.

changes.summary: Trade-process error messages now show the actual MFL response + a one-line diagnostic hint instead of the generic 'api returned 502 application/json'. The worker tries to sniff common MFL failure modes (commish lockout, trade deadline, invalid asset_id, missing/wrong APIKEY) and ships the diagnosis with the response.
details: Frontend trade submit handler: read response body BEFORE throwing (was throwing on !r.ok before reading the JSON body, which was hiding the worker's structured error).
Error display now formats: ⚠ <hint> · step: <step> · MFL: <response excerpt> · MFL HTTP <status>.
Worker /api/trade/process propose-fail: matches /lockout|locked|disabled/ → 'Likely cause: MFL Commissioner Lockout enabled. Disable in League → Commissioner Tools.'
Worker /api/trade/process accept-fail: same lockout sniff + 'already accepted' detection.
Other matched modes: /deadline|past|closed/ → trade deadline, /invalid|not own|asset/ → bad asset_id, /apikey|authentication/ → APIKEY problem.

changes.summary: DRY-RUN mode for LIVE rehearsal. Append ?dryrun=1 to the hub URL on a test site, flip Go LIVE, and Keith can exercise the entire submit flow (red banner, confirm dialog, button click, success toast, board update) without the worker actually POSTing to MFL or to the live #draft Discord channel. Posts a [DRY-RUN] preview to the test Discord channel instead, so the message format is verifiable.
details: Frontend: STATE.dryRun read from URL ?dryrun=1 (or sessionStorage rdh_dry_run). Propagated as `dry_run: true` in /api/pick + /api/trade + /api/trade/process payloads when in LIVE mode.
Banner: when LIVE+dryRun is active, pill reads 'LIVE • 🧪 DRY-RUN' on a red+amber 45° striped background — visually unmistakable.
Confirm dialog: Go LIVE rewords entirely when dryRun is active to call out the safe-rehearsal effect.
Worker /api/pick: dryRun short-circuits the MFL fetch — builds the request, returns the preview (with API key redacted), posts [DRY-RUN] to test Discord.
Worker /api/trade: dryRun skips the MFL tradeProposal POST, returns request preview.
Worker /api/trade/process: dryRun skips BOTH the propose and accept fetches, returns previews of both, posts the trade summary to test Discord.
Toggle: ?dryrun=0 forces it off; once set, persists in sessionStorage so a refresh keeps the dry-run state.

changes.summary: Commish trade-broker mode: when STATE.me.is_commish, the trade modal now exposes a 'From' dropdown alongside the existing 'To' dropdown — so the commish can pick ANY two franchises and process a trade between them. Previously the from-side was locked to the current user's franchise, making third-party brokering impossible (Keith hits this when logged in as MFL pseudo-franchise 0000, which has no roster).
details: openTradeModal: introduces let myFid + let myName (was const). When isCommishBroker is true, renders a 'From:' selector at the top with all franchises sorted alphabetically. To-selector dynamically rebuilds to exclude the new from-fid.
Basket titles + picker headers + cap-$ rule labels are team-aware: 'BLAKE BOMBERS OFFERS', 'KEITH RECEIVES', etc. instead of 'YOU OFFER' / 'YOU RECEIVE'.
Switching the From dropdown clears both baskets and reloads both pickers (assets belong to a different franchise now).
When commish is logged in as fid 0000 (no roster), the from-side defaults to the first franchise alphabetically. They can change it via the dropdown.
Audit field requested_by uses the commish's true fid (commishOwnFid) — not the from-team — so MFL/Discord show who actually ran the trade.

changes.summary: Pick clock no longer auto-starts when the page opens. The clock is a LIVE-mode-only feature now: hidden in SIM, kicked on at the moment of Go LIVE, cleared when flipping back to SIM. Auto-sim already has its own per-pick countdown, so the live-mode banner clock would have been a phantom timer during mock drafts.
details: renderPickClock(): bails (empty display) when STATE.simulationMode is true.
_pickClockEnsureStarted(): no-ops in SIM so we don't carry over a stale started_at if the user flips to LIVE later.
flipLiveMode() handler: SIM→LIVE stamps the clock from now (overwritten by MFL pick timestamp on the next refresh); LIVE→SIM clears state and re-renders the empty display.
Page-load bootstrap unchanged — it still calls the helpers, but they no-op cleanly in SIM (which is the default mode).

changes.summary: SIM mode no longer posts to Discord at all. Previously every simulated pick + simulated trade pinged the test channel with a [SIM] prefix. The test channel was getting flooded during owner mock drafts and the noise wasn't useful — the hub already shows the planned message in the confirm modal.
details: /api/pick simulate path: removed _rdhPostDiscord call. Response still returns the formatted message in `discord_message` so the client can preview it.
/api/trade simulate path: same — removed Discord post, kept `discord_message` in response.
/api/trade/process LIVE path: unchanged (commish-only, posts to live channel).
/api/pick LIVE path: unchanged (posts to live channel).

changes.summary: Reworded the LIVE-mode confirm dialog and mode-help modal — picks are NOT 'irreversible'. They go to MFL's live draft and Discord, but the commish can undo via Modify Draft Results in MFL and delete the Discord post. Hub itself has no undo button, but the underlying actions are recoverable.
details: flipLiveMode() confirm dialog: 'POST to MFL draftResults (irreversible)' → spelled out the actual effect + recovery path.
Trade Process confirm: 'IRREVERSIBLE without manual cleanup' → 'Recovery requires punching in a reverse trade manually'.
showModeHelp modal: added a 'What if I make a mistake in LIVE?' subsection with the recovery steps.

changes.summary: Commish detection now handles MFL's pseudo-franchise 0000 (the 'league owner' login that doesn't have its own roster). The HPM loader sniffs the ISMFLCOMMISH cookie on the outer MFL page (where MFL cookies are readable) and forwards an explicit window.UPS_DRAFT_HUB_IS_COMMISH flag into the iframe. Worker default COMMISH_FRANCHISE_IDS expanded to 0008,0000,0001.
details: site/rookies/mfl_hpm_embed_loader.js: detectIsCommish() reads document.cookie on the outer page for ISMFLCOMMISH=(1|Y|true); also true when FRANCHISE_ID resolves to 0000. Forwarded into iframe via window.UPS_DRAFT_HUB_IS_COMMISH.

Frontend: defensive commish block now checks (a) window.UPS_DRAFT_HUB_IS_COMMISH from HPM, (b) document.cookie ISMFLCOMMISH (same-origin only), (c) franchise_id in [0008,0001,0000], (d) ?commish=1 URL override. Any one is enough.
When commish-via-cookie/0000 is detected and no franchise_name is known, displays 'Commissioner' in the banner greeting.
Worker /api/me default COMMISH_FRANCHISE_IDS expanded from '0008,0001' to '0008,0000,0001'.

changes.summary: Belt-and-suspenders for the 'Go LIVE' commish toggle. Even if the worker /api/me call races HPM franchise injection or the user loads outside HPM context, the hub now sets is_commish locally for franchise 0008 (Keith) and 0001 (legacy fallback). Adds ?commish=1 URL override and console.info('[draft-hub] me:', ...) debug log.
details: Frontend: after the /api/me + HPM overlay, cross-check STATE.me.franchise_id against client-side COMMISH_FIDS_CLIENT = ['0008','0001']. Sets is_commish:true on match.
?commish=1 / ?commish=true → force is_commish:true (e.g. for testing on workers.dev preview without an HPM context).
?commish=0 / ?commish=false → force is_commish:false (hide the toggle).
console.info('[draft-hub] me:', ...) — surfaces what STATE.me looks like so the right answer to 'why don't I see Go LIVE?' is one DevTools peek away.

changes.summary: Per-pick countdown clock added to the live-mode banner. Default 10 minutes (UPS slow-draft cadence). LIVE clock seeds from the MFL timestamp of the previous pick; SIM clock stamps now whenever the auto-sim or a manual pick advances the slot.
details: Banner now shows MM:SS remaining next to the on-clock-headline. Color states: green >2min, amber 1-2min, red <60s, blinking-red OT (over time).
Clock minutes selector in the banner right column: Off / 2m / 5m / 10m (default) / 15m / 30m / 1h / 4h / 8h. Persisted to localStorage as rdh_pick_clock_mins.
↺ reset button restarts the current pick's clock from the moment of click (commish use: e.g. owner had a connectivity blip, give them the full clock back).
Frontend: STATE.activePickStartedAt (epoch ms) + STATE.activePickClockKey (slot fingerprint) + 1Hz tick repaint via setInterval.

LIVE seed: _refreshLiveDraftState() picks the most recent picks_made entry with a numeric MFL timestamp and uses that × 1000 as started_at. Falls back to first-observed-now if MFL didn't return a timestamp (e.g. pick #1).
SIM seed: _autoSimRecordPick + revert + reset all stamp now (or null + re-stamp) so the next slot's clock starts from zero.
Mobile: clock stays visible (smaller text), but the minutes selector and reset button are hidden — owners just watch.

changes.summary: Commish 'Go LIVE' toggle now appears for franchise 0008 (Real Deal Creel) by default — no Cloudflare secret required. Auto-sim Speed dropdown adds 1 min, 5 min, and 10 min/pick options for slow real-time drafts.
details: Worker default COMMISH_FRANCHISE_IDS changed from '0001' to '0008,0001'. /api/me now returns is_commish:true for Keith without setting a production secret. Override env var still wins if set.
site/rookies/rookie_draft_hub.html: <select id='auto-sim-speed'> gains 60000 / 300000 / 600000 ms options (1 / 5 / 10 min per pick). Existing 5s/10s/20s/Instant unchanged.
Tick progress bar already uses elapsed/speedMs ratio — works correctly for any duration; no JS change needed.

changes.summary: Live draft state now pulls from MFL on every load + auto-refreshes every 20s in LIVE mode. The 'snapshot 4/19/2026...' stamp is replaced with 'live from MFL HH:MM:SS' once the worker call lands.
details: New worker endpoint GET /api/draft-state — fetches MFL TYPE=draftResults (5s edge-cache) + TYPE=league (24h edge-cache), returns {franchises, draft_order, picks_made, active_pick, meta:{source:'mfl_live', as_of:<ISO>}}.

Frontend _refreshLiveDraftState() runs once on load (always, even in SIM) so the initial board reflects real picks. In LIVE mode it then polls every 20s. In SIM mode no polling — your local sim picks aren't overwritten.
Mode flip handler also kicks an immediate refresh on SIM→LIVE flip; clears the poll timer on LIVE→SIM.
SIM mode merge logic: LIVE picks (from MFL) + LOCAL sim picks (the user's rehearsal mutations) coexist, with MFL picks taking precedence at slots both sides have.
Board summary line now reads:
• 'X picks made · Y on the clock · live from MFL 11:45:23' when overlay succeeded
• 'X picks made · Y on the clock · snapshot 4/19/2026, 4:58:47 PM' fallback if worker unreachable
Toast on first LIVE-mode load: 'Live draft state loaded — N/72 picks made'.

changes.summary: New commish-only 'Process Trade' button in LIVE mode — when two owners agree on a trade verbally during the draft, the commish punches it in and the trade is processed immediately on both sides via MFL APIKEY (propose + auto-accept on behalf of partner). SIM act-as-partner panel rolled back per user request.
details: SIM mode behavior reverted to v1.7.1: trade auto-applies on submit, popup fires, Discord posts to test channel. No more 'act as partner' panel.
LIVE mode for non-commish owners unchanged from v1.7.2: 'Submit Proposal LIVE' → MFL records proposal → other team accepts in MFL UI.

LIVE mode for commish: button reads '🔨 Process Trade (Commish)'. Click triggers a confirm dialog showing both sides of the trade and 'irreversible' warning. On confirm, hits new /api/trade/process endpoint:
1. POST tradeProposal as fromFid → MFL records, returns trade_id
2. Parse trade_id from MFL response (handles 3 format variations)
3. POST tradeResponse with TRADE_ID + RESPONSE=accept + FRANCHISE_ID=toFid
4. Both sides committed in MFL — irreversible without manual cleanup
5. Discord post to LIVE channel: '🔄 TRADE PROCESSED (Commish) — Bombers ↔ Hawks · Bombers sends: 2027 R1 · Hawks sends: R1.07'
6. On-screen popup banner with red border (live styling)
Commish gate on the worker side: requested_by must match a franchise_id in COMMISH_FRANCHISE_IDS env var. 403 if not.

Use case: Eric and Blake have a discussion mid-draft, agree on a swap. Eric (or Blake) tells the commish. Commish opens trade modal, builds the trade, hits Process. Both teams' rosters/picks update in MFL within seconds. No back-and-forth proposal/acceptance choreography needed.

changes.summary: SIM trades no longer auto-apply on submit. Instead the trade modal shows an inline 'Act as <Partner>' panel with Accept / Counter / Decline buttons so the user can play both teams' roles in rehearsal.
details: SIM trade flow before: propose → submit → trade auto-applied to STATE → popup fired immediately. The user had no way to be the receiving team.
SIM trade flow now: propose → submit → 'Proposal sent to Bombers' message + inline action panel:
🎭 Now act as <PartnerName> and decide:
PartnerName sends: <their give summary>
PartnerName gets: <their receive summary>
[✓ Accept] [↻ Counter] [✕ Decline]
Accept → applies the trade to STATE, board updates, popup fires, sim Discord post (test channel) — 'PartnerName accepted'.
Counter → opens a fresh trade modal pre-populated with reversed terms (you become the partner sending what they would have offered, getting back what they would have received).
Decline → dismisses, no STATE mutation, toast 'PartnerName declined'.
LIVE flow unchanged from v1.7.2: 'Proposal sent — awaits acceptance' (real MFL acceptance happens in MFL UI).
Counter wiring reuses STATE._counterPrepopulate (same path as the inbox counter) — single code path for both 'I countered' and 'partner countered'.

changes.summary: LIVE-mode trade Discord post no longer fires on PROPOSAL submit. Real life: a proposal is just an offer until the other team accepts in MFL. Now: SIM mode auto-accepts (popup + Discord), LIVE mode shows 'Proposal sent — awaits acceptance' (no popup, no Discord) until the trade is actually accepted.
details: Worker /api/trade LIVE path: removed the Discord post on successful MFL proposal submission. Returns discord_message_preview (echo of what would be sent) instead, with note: 'Discord announcement will fire when the trade is accepted.'
Frontend LIVE submit handler: result message now reads '📤 Proposal sent to <Partner> — awaits their acceptance in MFL.' Toast updated. No celebratory popup.
Frontend SIM submit handler unchanged — still fires popup + Discord (sim has no real other side; auto-accept is the right semantic).

Inbox accept (incoming trade): /api/trades/proposals/action wires through the trade-workbench infrastructure for accept/decline. Discord post on accept is a TODO — that needs hooking into the existing trade-workbench accept handler (large blast radius, separate iteration).
deferred: Discord post when an INCOMING trade gets accepted in LIVE mode — needs to wire into /api/trades/proposals/action's existing accept flow (which already handles salary adjustments, extensions, taxi sync). Touches shared trade-workbench infrastructure; better as its own iteration with focused testing.

changes.summary: Removed the auto-generated other-owner trade simulator (was added in v1.7.0; not requested). Trade popup + Discord posts remain for USER-initiated trades only. Revert/commish controls already exist via the per-pick ↶ icon (commish-only in LIVE).
details: _simulateOtherTrade() removed — auto-sim no longer fires random pick swaps between non-user franchises.
Engine pick path is back to its v1.6.5 behavior: pick → record → schedule next tick. No trade injection.
Trade popup banner kept but only fires for user-initiated trades (sim-user variant or live variant). The 'sim-other' robot-emoji variant is removed.
Discord post on /api/trade kept for both sim and live paths — that part WAS requested.

Revert/commish controls (already in v1.4.2): hover any made pick on the board → ↶ icon → confirm modal with optional cascade-undo. _canRevert() gates LIVE-mode revert to commish-only (STATE.me.is_commish from COMMISH_FRANCHISE_IDS env var). Reset button on Mock Draft Sim card clears all local picks.

changes.summary: Trade announcements end-to-end. Auto-sim now generates pick-for-pick trades between random non-user franchises (~4% per pick, capped 1/round). Every trade — user-initiated or simulated — triggers an on-screen popup banner that slides in from the top. User-initiated trades also post to Discord (test channel in SIM, live channel in LIVE).
details: _simulateOtherTrade() during auto-sim: picks two random non-user franchises with 2+ unmade picks, swaps a random pick from each, mutates STATE.live.draft_order ownership, recomputes active_pick, logs to STATE.live._sim_trade_log to enforce per-round cap.
Cap: max 1 simulated other-owner trade per round (historical UPS draft-day average is ~3-5/draft total = roughly 1 every ~2 rounds). Random firing keeps it feeling organic.
showTradePopup({fromName, toName, fromGives, toGives, source}) — slides in from top center of viewport, auto-dismisses after 8s, Cancel ✕ button. Three sources distinguish styling:
• 'sim-other' (engine-generated, accent border, 🤖 prefix)
• 'sim-user' (user-initiated sim, accent border, no 🤖)
• 'live' (real MFL trade, red border, glow background)
Worker /api/trade now posts to Discord on BOTH paths:
• simulate=true → posts to TEST channel with [SIM] prefix
• LIVE (mflOk) → posts to LIVE channel
Discord message format: '🔄 TRADE — Bombers ↔ Hawks · Bombers sends: 2027 R1 · Hawks sends: R1.07' with optional comments quoted.
Asset IDs decoded: FP_<orig>_<yr>_<rd> → '<yr> R<rd>'; DP_<rd-1>_<slot-1> → 'R<rd>.<slot>'; BB_<amt> → '$<amt>'; P_<id> → 'Player #<id>' (best-effort without name lookup).
Simulated other-owner trades show popup ONLY (no Discord) to keep rehearsal noise in your tab.
Mobile: popup spans full width with edge padding; same animation.

changes.summary: Queue auto-pick was only QUEUING the prospect (setting on-clock card), not actually submitting. Now in SIM mode it auto-submits after a 3-second cancel window. LIVE mode still requires manual confirmation (we never auto-write to MFL).
details: When auto-pick is ON + you're on the clock + queue has an eligible prospect: a yellow 'Auto-picking <Name> in 3s' banner appears in the on-clock card with a visible countdown and a Cancel button.
After 3s with no cancel: the pick is recorded locally (in sim mode) and the auto-sim resumes if running.
Cancel button OR clicking any other prospect cancels the pending auto-pick.
LIVE mode: only sets selectedProspect (queue head shows in on-clock card), does NOT auto-submit — you must click Draft Player and confirm in the modal. Auto-submitting an MFL write is too risky.
Pulse animation on the pending banner so it's obvious; respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Module-level _autoPickTimer + _autoPickPid prevent multiple stacked timers across re-renders.

changes.summary: Two production-only bugs fixed: (1) trade modal showed 'Player #16432' instead of real names because /api/franchise-assets only returned IDs (rosters endpoint doesn't carry names); (2) trade modal opened off-screen when the iframe is taller than the viewport.
details: Worker /api/franchise-assets now does 5 parallel fetches: rosters + futureDraftPicks + draftResults + TYPE=players (24h cached, ~2MB) + TYPE=league (24h cached). Builds a player_id → {name, position, team} map and joins it to roster IDs. Names flip 'Last, First' → 'First Last' for display. Players sorted by salary desc.
Future picks now show 'via <Team Name>' for trade-acquired picks (was 'orig 0008'), pulling franchise names from TYPE=league.

openModal() now postMessages parent ('draft-hub-modal-open') AND scrolls iframe to top. mfl_hpm_embed_loader.js listens and scrollIntoView's the iframe so modals land in the visible viewport regardless of iframe height.
Verified locally: /api/franchise-assets?fid=0008 returns 'Marvin Harrison Jr.' / 'TreVeyon Henderson' / 'Tetairoa McMillan' with correct positions + salaries.

changes.summary: Queue auto-pick is now OPT-IN. The owner has to tick a checkbox to enable auto-selection of their queue head when their pick comes up. Default is OFF — every pick gets manually confirmed unless you explicitly turn it on.
details: New checkbox in the My Queue card: '🤖 Auto-pick top of queue when I'm on the clock'. Default unchecked.
_maybeAutoSelectFromQueue() bails immediately if the checkbox isn't ticked.
Toast on toggle confirms which mode you're in.
Persists in sessionStorage per franchise (rdh_queue_autopick_{fid}).
Helper hint text rewritten to reflect the new default ('Auto-pick is OFF by default — you confirm every pick yourself unless you tick the box above (or the commish runs auto-draft for you)').
Commish path unchanged: the auto-draft engine still picks for any non-user franchise as before. The queue auto-pick is purely the owner's own opt-in for THEIR slot.

changes.summary: My Team card now includes a collapsible position-grouped Roster section (QB / RB / WR / TE / DL / LB / DB / PK / PN). Plus a phone-rendering pass: tighter cards, full-screen modals, hidden non-essentials at <420px.
details: ROSTER SECTION — collapsed by default to keep My Team compact when not needed. Click 'Roster · 24 players · $187K' header to open. Inside, each position group is its own nested <details>: 'QB × 2 · $43K ▾'. Tap the position to expand a list of players sorted by salary (highest first) with name + position+contract-year + salary chip.
Position buckets: QB / RB / WR / TE (offense), DL (DE/DT/NT/EDGE roll-up), LB (LB/ILB/OLB), DB (CB/S/FS/SS), PK, PN. Buckets with 0 players are hidden.
PHONE PASS — new @media (max-width: 640px) block tightens almost everything:
• Tab strip horizontally scrolls
• Live-mode banner shrinks pill, drops greeting at <420px
• Card padding 16px → 10px
• Mock Draft Sim hero scales down; controls stack to 1 col; disclaimer tightens
• My Team / My Queue / On-the-Clock card heads compact
• Trade modal goes full-screen (100vw × 100vh, no border-radius) instead of trying to fit a wide layout in a narrow viewport
• Player profile modal also full-screen with smaller headshot (80px instead of 110px)
• Rank-by picker dropdown extends edge-to-edge
At <420px (small phones): hides board pk-team line and tier % chips inside cells to save vertical space; further compresses banner.
Submit-pick button stays at min-height: 44px (Apple HIG tap target) on every breakpoint.

changes.summary: Hub now honors a ?api= URL param to point at a local wrangler dev worker (no rebuild needed). Persists in sessionStorage so subsequent loads in the same tab keep using it. Added worker/.dev.vars.example template + .gitignore for .dev.vars.
details: _resolveApiBaseFromUrl() runs at script load — reads ?api=<url> and sets window.UPS_DRAFT_HUB_API_BASE + caches in sessionStorage as 'rdh_api_base'.
Reaches every /api/* call via apiUrl(). Stays empty in production HPM context (the embed loader sets it to the prod workers.dev URL).

worker/.dev.vars.example documents the required local-dev secrets (DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, MFL_APIKEY, COMMISH_FRANCHISE_IDS=0008). User copies to .dev.vars and fills in the values from Discord Developer Portal + their league APIKEY. Wrangler auto-loads on next dev start.
worker/.gitignore now blocks .dev.vars from being committed.

changes.summary: Auto-Draft card promoted to 'Mock Draft Simulation' with hero treatment — gradient text title, glow stripe at top, accent-soft border, status pill. Dashed-border disclaimer block addresses Bousquet's data-harvesting concerns directly: 'No Bousquet, I am not harvesting this data. All sim state lives locally in your browser sessionStorage. #sorrynotsorry'
details: Card border switched from neutral to accent-soft + faint vertical gradient background.
2px gradient stripe (accent → purple → accent) at the top of the card draws the eye.
Title is now an 17px gradient-text 'Mock Draft Simulation' with 22px 🎲 emoji + drop-shadow glow.
Status badge ('Idle / Running / Paused / Your pick / Draft complete') is now a pill with uppercase letterspaced text.
Disclaimer block: dashed border, panel-alt background, 11px text. Strong 'No Bousquet' opener, code-styled 'sessionStorage' callout, italic warm-amber #sorrynotsorry sign-off.

changes.summary: Profile bio gets a 'Watch + Read' row of search links — opens fresh YouTube + Google searches in new tabs. Better than embedding (no API key, no quota, search results always current).
details: Decision: link instead of embed. YouTube only embeds specific video IDs (which would require either YouTube Data API + quota OR hand-curating a video per player — neither scales). Search-result links keep the experience fresh (top videos rotate as new highlights post) and add zero infra.
Links shown depend on whether the player is a fresh rookie or veteran:
• Fresh rookie: '🎬 College highlights' (YouTube), '🏈 NFL highlights' (when signed), '📋 Combine + workout' (YouTube), '📰 Scouting report' (Google)
• Veteran: '🏈 NFL highlights' (YouTube), '📰 News + analysis' (Google)
All links open in new tab with rel=noopener noreferrer.
Query templates use the player's full name + their college (rookies) or NFL team (vets). Quoted name in Google searches for tighter matching.
Skipped for ancient veterans with no current-year prospect record AND existing career stats — those have plenty of data already.

changes.summary: Two new right-rail cards: 'My Team' (your picks owned this draft + future picks + roster snapshot) and 'My Queue' (prospect stack in priority order with reorder + clear + auto-select on your turn). Click '+' on any prospect to queue them. Drafted prospects auto-trim from the queue. Per-franchise persistence in sessionStorage.
details: My Team card at the top of the right rail. Shows team name, picks left this draft (next-up chip in green), future picks (year + round), and roster snapshot (player count + combined salary from the franchise_assets_2026.json snapshot).

My Queue card below. Each row: priority # · position · player name · consensus rank · ▲ move up / ▼ move down / ✕ remove. Top available is highlighted in green (the one that auto-selects on your turn).
New '+' button on every prospect row in the prospect list (next to the ⓘ profile button). Click to queue. Already-queued shows ✓ and is disabled. Drafted prospects show + greyed out + disabled.
Auto-trim: drafted prospects are removed from the queue on every render (renderMyQueue runs after renderProspects in renderLive).

Auto-select: when the user's franchise is on the clock AND nothing is queued in the on-clock card, the top non-drafted prospect from My Queue is promoted to STATE.selectedProspect so the Draft Player button is one-click-ready.
Per-franchise persistence: queue key is `rdh_queue_{fid}` in sessionStorage. Switching franchises (via the auto-sim Play-as dropdown or via a different ?F= URL) loads a different queue.
Clear button on the My Queue card with confirm dialog.

changes.summary: Removed the 'Consensus rank blends: MFL Rookie ADP · MFL Dynasty ADP · ...' attribution footer at the bottom of the live tab. Source detail is still visible per-prospect in the rank-cell tooltip and on the on-clock card chips.
details:
Removed the

element from the HTML.
Removed renderAdpSourcesFooter() from the JS and the call in renderAll().

Source visibility is preserved where it actually matters: the rank-by picker dropdown (which sources you blend), the rank-cell tooltip on each prospect row (per-source breakdown for that player), and the on-clock card chips (MFL #X · FC #Y · KTC #Z · SLP #W · FP #V).

changes.summary: Rookie profile cleanup pass: ESPN college headshots, decimal age (21.4 not 21), 'Stats / Game Log / News' tabs stripped for rookies (Bio only), 'League Status' block hidden when there's nothing meaningful, modal glass effect removed (now opaque), 'Select none' button removed.
details: Headshots: chained fallback img.onerror — MFL icon_url → ESPN college (a.espncdn.com/i/headshots/college-football/players/full/{espn_id}.png) → ESPN NFL → MFL stable archive (player_photos_2014/{pid}_thumb.jpg). Fresh rookies who don't have an MFL photo yet now show their college portrait via espn_id (already in our prospect data).

Age: now decimal (e.g. 21.4yo). build_prospects() computes via (today − birthdate).total_seconds() / (365.25 * 86400), rounded to 1 dp. Eligibility window widened to 16.5–36 to catch all rookies. Display sites already use {p.age}yo so no JS change needed.

League Status block: hidden entirely when bundle has no team_name, no FA flag, no injury, no acquisition, AND tier is unset/Unclassified. Was showing 'Status: Unknown · Hub Tier: UNCLASSIFIED' for every rookie — pure noise.

Tab strip: for fresh rookies (career_summary empty AND in current-year prospect board), the Stats / Game Log / News tabs are removed and the body shows just the Bio block. Veterans get the full tab strip as before.
Modal glass: rdh-modal-overlay scrim went from rgba(8,11,18,0.88) + 2px backdrop-blur → rgba(0,0,0,0.96) with NO blur. Modal is fully opaque. No more 'glass' bleed.
Select none button removed from the rank-by-picker — empty selection wasn't allowed anyway (it re-ticked all). 'All sources' button kept for the reset case.

changes.summary: Normalized rookie ranks for SuperFlex (UPS format). Switched FantasyPros from the 1QB /adp/rookies page to the /rankings/dynasty-rookies-superflex page (158 rookies, embedded ecrData JSON). Each source in the consensus picker is now labeled SF or 1QB-blended so the user knows what they're blending. New 'SF only' shortcut.
details: FantasyPros: switched scrape target to /rankings/dynasty-rookies-superflex.php which embeds an `ecrData = {...}` JS variable with full SF expert consensus. Cleaner than HTML scraping AND properly SF-calibrated (Mendoza is #2 SF vs #9 in their 1QB rookie ADP). Now includes rank_min, rank_max, rank_ave, tier alongside rank_ecr.
Note: ?2qb=1 query param on the /adp/rookies page is silently ignored — returns the same 1QB list. Only the /rankings page distinguishes SF.
Source meta: every source now carries `format` ('sf' or 'blended') + `format_note` explaining why. Surfaces in the picker as a green SF or amber 1QB badge next to the source name.
Picker UI: rows grouped under 'SuperFlex (matches UPS)' (FantasyCalc, KTC, FantasyPros) and 'Blended (1QB-skewed)' (MFL Rookie, Sleeper). Section heads make the grouping visible at a glance.
New 'SF only' shortcut button: ticks the 3 SF-native sources only, un-ticks MFL + Sleeper. Summary label reads 'SF only · 3 SF-native sources'.

Verified: Ty Simpson (QB sleeper) lands at consensus #10 with the new FP feed (FP #8, KTC #10, FC #10, SLP #14, MFL #16). Without SF normalization he'd be ~#16 — a real-world SF mistake the engine would otherwise make.
Sleeper renamed in the picker from 'Sleeper SF' to just 'Sleeper' since their search_rank is overall (1QB-leaning by default), not SF-specific.

changes.summary: Added FantasyPros rookie ADP scrape (5th source). Replaced the single-source 'Rank by' pill with a custom-consensus picker: a checkbox dropdown that lets the user pick which sources blend into the displayed consensus rank.
details: FantasyPros rookie ADP scraper: /nfl/adp/rookies.php public HTML page (their /api is auth-locked). Parses the table#data rows for rank, fp_id, name, team, position, avg_pick. 133 rookies pulled.
Top 5 prospects now have 5-source consensus. Delp consensus #42 across MFL #42, FC #34, KTC #43, SLP #139, FP #34 — the FP signal corroborates FantasyCalc's view that he's a slight reach at #42.
Custom consensus picker (replaces the old segmented pill):
• Click 'Rank by: Consensus · all sources' to open a dropdown with checkboxes for each source (MFL Rookie ADP, FantasyCalc SF, KeepTradeCut SF, Sleeper SF, FantasyPros Rookie).
• Tick/un-tick to define your own consensus blend. Median is computed live from the selected subset.
• 'Select all' / 'Select none' shortcuts. Empty selection isn't allowed (re-ticks all with a toast).
• Persists in sessionStorage so a refresh keeps your blend.
• Summary label shows 'Consensus · all sources' / 'Custom · N of 5 sources' / 'Single · ktc'.
• The selected source-set drives BOTH the displayed rank number AND the sort order. Per-prospect 'Nsrc' chip reflects how many of the SELECTED sources actually have that prospect.
• Tooltip on the rank cell shows the full per-source breakdown for context.

Probed but rejected: DynastyDataLab (Nuxt SPA with minified bundle and an opaque api.dynastydatalab.com that 404s on every guessed endpoint — would need to either run a headless browser or reverse-engineer their JS bundle; noted as a future TODO if it stays high-signal).

changes.summary: Added Sleeper SF as a 4th live rookie-ranking source. Probed FantasyPros, DraftSharks, DynastyDaddy, and Sleeper /adp — only Sleeper had open public data with current 2026 rookies (152 ranked, joins on rotowire_id with 147 hits = 97% match rate).
details: Sleeper search_rank is overall fantasy rank — re-ranked rookies among themselves to get a SF-style rookie rank.
Join key: rotowire_id (Sleeper exposes it; MFL DETAILS=1 also exposes it). 97% of Sleeper rookies matched to an MFL prospect by rotowire_id; rest fall back to name match.
Consensus rank (median across non-null sources) now blends 4 live sources: MFL Rookie ADP, FantasyCalc SF, KeepTradeCut SF, Sleeper SF. (DynastyProcess still wired for when they catch up to 2026.)
Top 5 prospects now have 4-source consensus. Delp at consensus #42.5 with Sleeper as the 4th data point (Sleeper has him at #139 — illustrative of WHY median is robust to one-source outliers).
UI: 'Sleeper' button added to the Rank-by segmented control. On-clock breakdown chips include 'SLP #N'. Profile-card pre-NFL banner lists Sleeper rank too.
FantasyCalc bonus: their feed now exposes mflId for 60 of 70 rookies (was 0 last week) — better join coverage all around.
Probed but rejected: FantasyPros (locked behind auth), DraftSharks (404), DynastyDaddy (empty response), Sleeper /adp endpoint (404). Notes left in the fetcher for future revisits.

changes.summary: Removed the cryptic '(press / to focus)' hint from the prospect-search placeholder. The slash shortcut still works — discoverable via the keyboard-shortcuts footer at the bottom of the tab and the ? help modal.
details: Placeholder now reads simply 'Search prospects…' instead of 'Search prospects…  (press / to focus)'.
The `/`, `Esc`, and `?` shortcuts are still wired and listed in the discoverable help locations — just no longer cluttering the input.

changes.summary: Stopped auto-injecting synthetic trade offers from random franchises during auto-draft. The Incoming Trades inbox card is now hidden in simulate mode entirely — appears only in LIVE mode for real proposals from real owners.
details: Removed the ~12% per-pick chance of a synthetic offer from another franchise during auto-sim. Those offers were unrealistic (real owners don't randomly send trade pressure during a draft) and noisy.
Inbox card hidden in SIM via card.hidden=true, restored when flipping to LIVE.
Inbox refresh button in SIM now toasts 'Inbox is live-mode only — propose your own trade in sim instead.' instead of generating a fake offer.
Removed the dead _simSyntheticOffer() function (~40 lines).
Mode-flip handler also drops any leftover items when entering SIM (paranoia — there shouldn't be any since the polling stopped).
Reasoning: the user can propose their own trades in sim to test the trade flow + the board mutation. Receiving fake offers from teams who'd never send them in real life just clutters the rehearsal.

changes.summary: Removed the 'Search Any Player' panel from the prospect rail. The prospect search above already covers the rookie pool, and looking up veterans during a draft isn't a real workflow.
details: HTML: removed the <details id="player-search-panel"> block under the prospect filters.
JS: removed wirePlayerSearch() and doPlayerSearch() functions plus the wirePlayerSearch() call in wireLiveDraftListeners().
Worker /api/players-search endpoint left in place (no client uses it; harmless and may be revived for a different surface).

changes.summary: Three trade-modal fixes: (1) clear 'You're on the clock' banner appears in the on-clock card whenever the active pick belongs to your franchise — no more confusion about why the Draft Player button is greyed out after a trade swap; (2) cap-$ (BB) trade rule enforced per docs/league_context_v1.md §E1 — max sent = 50% of YOUR outgoing player salaries, not pooled, and trade must include at least one non-cash asset on each side that has cap-$; (3) cap-$ + comments fields no longer have placeholder ghost text that looked like pre-filled values.
details: On-clock banner: a green 'You're on the clock' callout sits above the queued-prospect block whenever STATE.live.active_pick.franchise_id matches the user's franchise. Tells them whether to click a prospect (none queued) or confirm below (one queued). Solves the problem from the user's report: 'I made a trade and the board moved up but it's not allowing me to pick.'
Cap-$ (BB) trade rule (UPS §E1): each side's max cap money sent = 50% × sum of THAT side's outgoing player salaries. NOT pooled. Multi-player trades sum the salaries first.

Live helper text under the cap-$ row reads: 'Cap $ rule: YOU OFFER max = $X (N players · combined salary $Y) · already added $Z · $REMAINING left'. Updates whenever the basket changes or the user toggles which side they're adding cap-$ to.
Add-cap-$ button validates: must be > 0, must have at least one player on that side first (max=0 otherwise), cannot exceed remaining cap-$ allowance. Failures show a toast.
Submit handler also re-validates cap-$ totals (a user could remove players after adding BB$ which would invalidate the trade) and the 'must include non-cash asset' rule before submitting.

BB$ field placeholder removed (was '5000' which looked pre-filled). Comments field placeholder removed (was 'Optional comments…' which looked pre-filled). Both inputs get autocomplete=off so browser autofill doesn't add ghost values.

Cap-$ field renamed from 'Blind Bid $' to 'Cap $ (BB)' since it's a CAP-MONEY adjustment recorded as a salary_adjustment row, not a literal blind-bid auction nomination — matches league_context terminology.

changes.summary: Hard guard against duplicate picks. The same player_id can never be added to picks_made twice (was producing Stribling at 2.09 AND 3.09, Sadiq Kenyon at 1.07 AND 1.09 in some sims). Same-slot conflicts are also blocked.
details: _autoSimRecordPick now checks STATE.live.picks_made for an existing entry with the same player_id. If found, the new pick is BLOCKED with a console.error showing both attempt sites + a toast for the user.
Same-slot guard: refuses to add a second pick at the same round.slot.
Prospect-row click in the rail now blocks queueing an already-drafted prospect (was relying on the click handler letting it through, then the engine deduping later).
On-the-Clock 'Draft Player' button is disabled (greyed-out, cursor:not-allowed) when the queued prospect is already drafted somewhere — with a tooltip showing the slot they were taken at.
Errors are surfaced rather than silently swallowed — root cause of the duplicate selection (race / stale closure / synthetic-offer leak) will now be visible in the console next time it triggers.

changes.summary: Auto-draft engine no longer takes defense in early rounds and never doubles up on defense in the same round. Per-round defense penalty calibrated against the actual UPS draft history (2020+).
details: Per-round defense penalty added to score: R1=+80 (impossible), R2=+50 (very rare), R3=+28 (rare), R4=+26 (creeping in), R5=+25 (common), R6=0 (filter handles it).

Same-round double-up penalty: if a franchise already drafted a defensive player THIS round, defense candidates get an extra penalty (R1=+100, R2=+80, R3=+50, R4=+30, R5=+22). Historical rate of double-up was <2% so this is effectively a hard block in early rounds.
Defense-heavy owners (offense_pct < 0.45) get a 40% reduction on the defense penalty — they're more likely than average to take a defender, just not in R1-R2.
Validated with 300-iteration sim against rookie_draft_history.json: simulated def% per round matches historical within ~1%pt across R1-R5. Same-round doubles: 0 per draft (matches reality).
Calibration table:
R1: sim 0% / hist 0% / 0 doubles
R2: sim 0% / hist 2% / 0 doubles
R3: sim 8% / hist 9% / 0 doubles
R4: sim 26% / hist 26% / 0 doubles
R5: sim 28% / hist 27% / 0 doubles

changes.summary: Profile card now falls back to the prospect-board record when the MFL bundle is empty (fixes the empty bio for current-year rookies in local preview). Simulated trades now mutate STATE.live.draft_order in real time so the board reflects pick swaps the instant a sim trade is accepted.
details: Profile bio: when bundle.profile.playerProfile.player is empty (always in local preview, often for fresh rookies), pull height/weight/college/age/draft_summary from the prospect record we already loaded. ESPN ID surfaces as a clickable link to their college page.

Pre-NFL banner above the bio fields when career_summary is empty AND the player exists in the 2026 prospect board: shows draft summary, NFL signing team, and the consensus rank with per-source breakdown (MFL #X · FC #Y · KTC #Z).

Sim trades — proposed: after a simulate trade succeeds, _applySimTradeToState walks the give/receive baskets and re-assigns ownership of any current-year picks (DP_year_round_slot) in STATE.live.draft_order. Future picks (FP_*) and player swaps are recorded in STATE.live._sim_future_pick_moves / _sim_player_swaps for downstream display but the rookie hub doesn't render rosters here.

Sim trades — incoming inbox: accepting a synthetic offer also applies the swap. From the recipient's POV, offer.give → flows from recipient to proposer, offer.receive → flows from proposer to recipient.

Real-time consequence: if you trade your 1.09 for the partner's 1.08 in sim mode, the BOARD instantly shows your franchise on 1.08 and the partner's on 1.09, and the auto-sim engine picks for the new owners on the next tick.

Synthetic offer generator now tags every snapshot record with kind ('player' / 'dp' / 'fp') and asks for a pick-swap 50% of the time (vs random asset mix) so users get to see the board mutation more often during rehearsal.
Toast on successful sim trade reads 'Trade simulated — board updated (N picks swapped)' when picks moved.

changes.summary: Revert / undo individual picks. SIMULATE mode: any user can revert any pick. LIVE mode: commissioner-only, with a clear warning that MFL must be corrected manually since MFL has no clean draftResults undo API.
details: Hover over a made pick cell on the board → small ↶ icon appears in the slot label. Click it to open the revert confirmation modal.
Permission gate via _canRevert(): SIM mode returns true for everyone; LIVE mode requires STATE.me.is_commish.
Revert modal shows the player + franchise + slot label being reverted. If LIVE, a red banner reminds the commissioner to also undo in MFL admin tools.

If picks were made AFTER the slot being reverted, an amber warning explains the choice — and a second 'Revert this + N after' button appears for cascade-undo (useful when re-running an auto-sim from a specific point).
Revert mutates STATE.live.picks_made + AUTO_SIM.history + restores active_pick to the earliest unmade slot via _autoSimNextSlot().
↶ icon stays hidden until the cell is hovered — keeps the board visually clean. Hover affordance is opacity 0.85 → 1.0 on hover with a soft red background.
No new worker call yet — LIVE undo is hub-state-only (commish must manually correct MFL). A /api/pick/undo worker endpoint is a follow-up if the manual MFL step gets annoying.

changes.summary: Pre-trade extension dropdown corrected to mirror site/trades/trade_workbench.js + docs/league_context_v1.md §C4 exactly. The previous fabricated options (3YR, Front-Loaded, Back-Loaded) violated UPS rules and have been removed.
details: Only valid extensions are Ext1 (1YR) and Ext2 (2YR) — confirmed in league_context_v1.md:299-312 and trade_workbench.js buildSyntheticExtensionOptions().
Removed: 3YR, Front-Loaded, Back-Loaded extension options (loading is for FA/ERA multi-year contracts, NOT for extensions).
Per-asset position-based AAV escalator added (mirrors trade_workbench.js PRETRADE_EXTENSION_RAISES at line 11):
Schedule 1 (QB/RB/WR/TE): +$10K (1yr) / +$20K (2yr)
Schedule 2 (DL/LB/DB/PK/PN/OTHER): +$3K (1yr) / +$5K (2yr)
Dropdown now shows the COMPUTED new AAV in the option label (e.g. '+1yr (Ext1) · new AAV $27K') so the proposing owner sees what they're committing to. Mirrors the trade workbench's preview behavior.
Basket pill now reads 'Ext1' / 'Ext2' (matches MFL contract_type token) instead of the raw '1YR'/'2YR' code.
Eligibility check still defers to the worker — UI offers the option, MFL/worker enforces (must have 1yr remaining or be expired-rookie pre-deadline; no tags; no 'no further extensions' players).

changes.summary: Incoming Trades inbox in the right rail with Accept / Counter / Decline. Live mode polls the existing /api/trades/proposals worker endpoint every 30s. Simulate mode auto-injects synthetic offers from random franchises during auto-draft so the user can rehearse responding to trade pressure.
details: New 'Incoming Trades' card under On-the-Clock with a pulsing red badge showing the pending offer count.
Click any inbox row to open a Trade Detail modal showing both baskets ('YOU RECEIVE' green, 'YOU GIVE' red) plus comments and three action buttons.
Accept (green): in LIVE mode POSTs to /api/trades/proposals/action with action=accept; in SIM mode just clears from local inbox.
Decline (red): same wiring with action=decline.

Counter (amber): swaps and copies the offer's baskets into a fresh proposal — opens openTradeModal pre-populated with reversed terms + the proposing partner already selected. User edits and submits as a new proposal. The original offer is removed from the inbox (it's superseded).

Live polling: every 30s when not in simulate mode. Polling auto-stops when flipping to SIM and auto-starts when flipping back to LIVE. Simulated items are dropped from the inbox on LIVE flip so users don't act on them.

Simulate-mode synthetic offers: ~12% chance per engine pick during auto-draft that another franchise sends YOU an offer (random give from your snapshot, random receive from theirs, random one-line comment). Caps at 2 pending offers so the inbox doesn't spam during sim.
Manual refresh button: in SIM forces a synthetic offer; in LIVE forces an immediate poll.
Reuses the existing trade-workbench worker endpoints (/api/trades/proposals + /api/trades/proposals/action) — no new worker code required.

Counter wiring: STATE._counterPrepopulate carries {partner_fid, give[], receive[], comments, original_offer_id} into the next openTradeModal call, which consumes it once and pre-populates baskets + partner select + comments.

changes.summary: Trade modal: opaque scrim (no more glass bleed), all picks under one 'Draft Picks' section, BB$ promoted to a single inline row, and pre-trade extensions wired the same way as trade_workbench.js. Submit no longer crashes when the worker is unreachable in local preview.
details: Modal overlay scrim is now rgba(8,11,18,0.88) + 2px backdrop-blur — page content no longer bleeds through. Z-index lifted to 1000 so sticky banners + on-clock cards can't punch through. Modal box gets a 0/20/60 box-shadow for clear separation.
Combined 'Future Picks' + 'Current-Year Picks' into one 'Draft Picks' section. Current-year picks come first (sorted by round/slot), then future picks (sorted by year/round).
BB$ promoted out of the collapsed 'optional' details — sits as a single inline row in the footer alongside the comments box. Always visible, easier to discover.

Pre-trade extension dropdown per player asset in the basket — same 10 option_keys the trade workbench uses (1YR / 2YR / 3YR Veteran / Front-Loaded / Back-Loaded). Selected extension shows as an accent-colored pill on the basket row.

Trade payload now sends both legacy flat give[]/receive[] arrays AND rich give_assets[]/receive_assets[] objects with extension_term — so the worker can opt into the richer shape without breaking back-compat.

Trade submit handler wraps the fetch in a content-type check (matches the /api/franchise-assets pattern). Local-preview simulate trades succeed via a stub when the worker is unreachable — was crashing with 'SyntaxError: The string did not match the expected pattern' before.
deferred: Accept / counter / decline workflow for INCOMING trade offers — needs a new inbox view, counter-offer composer, and worker endpoints for /api/trades/respond. Tracked as a separate v1.4.0 follow-up since it touches D1 + the worker, not just the hub UI.

changes.summary: Live tab restructured: full-width draft board on top (all 12 picks per round visible), prospects + on-the-clock side-by-side underneath. Click-anchored modal positioning removed everywhere — every modal now centers via the overlay flexbox.
details: Layout v3: was 3-col (prospects | board | on-clock). Now 1-col board on top, 2-col below (prospects 360px | right-rail 1fr).
Board cells bigger and more readable: min-height 64px, font 12px, slot label 12px bold, player name with line-through when drafted.
Board stays 12-wide down to 720px viewport; collapses to 6-wide on phone, 4-wide on small phone.
Board legend (made / on-clock / queued) sits directly below the grid.
openModal() no longer reads _lastClickY — every modal centers via the overlay's flexbox. Trade modal dropped its custom fixed-positioning override since the overlay now handles it.
On-the-Clock card no longer 'sticky' — was getting in the way at narrow widths since it now sits in the right rail under the board.

changes.summary: Trade modal redesigned around a four-region layout (sticky header / sticky baskets strip / scrollable pickers / sticky footer) so the user can always see what they're offering AND the submit button regardless of how long the asset list is.
details: Modal is centered in viewport (was anchored to click-Y, which often pushed it off-screen for trade interactions).

New 'baskets strip' near the top: 'YOU OFFER' (red border) on the left, 'YOU RECEIVE' (green border) on the right, with a ⇄ divider. Always visible — no scrolling required to see what's in the cart. Each basket has a count chip (e.g. '3 assets').
Pickers occupy the middle scrollable region. Inner asset lists no longer have nested scroll boxes — the body scrolls as one unit, no fighting overflow zones.
Submit + Cancel buttons live in a sticky footer at the bottom. Always reachable.
Trade-partner select moved to the header (next to '↔ Trade with:'); BB$ + comments moved into a collapsed 'optional' details disclosure to declutter the default view.
Submit button label switches between 'Simulate Trade' (amber) and '🔴 Submit Proposal LIVE' (red) based on STATE.simulationMode.
Removed click-Y positioning override for the trade modal — fixed center positioning works better for tall content.

changes.summary: Future draft picks acquired in trades now display the original team name + owner ('2027 R1 (via HammerTime · Eric Martel)') instead of the cryptic franchise ID ('orig 0005').
details: snapshot_franchise_assets.py — added fetch_franchise_names() that pulls team names from MFL TYPE=league, then overlays owner names from rookie_draft_team_tendencies.json. Tendencies file is keyed by owner_name (not fid) and a single fid can have multiple historical owners — picks the active one (is_active=true).
Future-pick display string: '2027 R1' for own picks, '2027 R1 (via <Team Name> · <Owner>)' for picks acquired via trade.

Each future-pick record now carries original_team_name and original_owner_name fields (in addition to the legacy original_fid) so the hub can format display strings any way it wants without re-doing the lookup.
Verified Keith's franchise (0008): 2027 R1 (via HammerTime 🔨 ⏰ · Eric Martel), 2027 R1 (own), R2 (own), R3 (own), R4 (own), R5 (own).

changes.summary: Trade modal expanded to 1180px with taller scroll regions; real player rosters now visible in local preview via a static MFL snapshot. Modal classes are reset between opens (no more bio-modal CSS leaking into trade modal).
details: Trade modal CSS: max-width 1180px (was 860), max-height 92vh, inner picker boxes 280px (was 140), basket boxes 180px scrollable. Two-column grid collapses to one at <900px.
openModal() now strips per-modal modifier classes when reused; openTradeModal applies .rdh-modal-trade so the wider rules kick in.

New script: pipelines/etl/scripts/snapshot_franchise_assets.py — pulls MFL rosters + future picks + current-year unmade picks for all 12 franchises and writes site/rookies/franchise_assets_2026.json (12 franchises · 283 players · 60 future picks).

Hub loads the snapshot lazily on boot (non-blocking). When /api/franchise-assets is unreachable in local preview, the trade modal falls back to the snapshot — players, salaries, future picks, and current-year picks all render. Banner notes 'static snapshot (timestamp)'.
Current-year picks always come from live STATE so simulated picks don't reappear as available.
Rookie players show up in the snapshot as part of each franchise's roster once their draft pick is recorded in MFL — until then the live worker is needed for true real-time data.

changes.summary: Auto-draft engine now uses tier-based sampling driven by continuous MFL ADP gaps. Lone consensus #1s (Love at 1.46 ADP, 2.24 gap to Tate) go deterministically; tight clusters (Tyson/Price/Lemon/Mendoza all at ADP 5.5-6.5) shuffle realistically. Trade modal in local preview no longer crashes when /api/franchise-assets is unreachable.
details: Replaced gaussian jitter + fixed top-N sampling with a tier walker. Walks the score-sorted list and starts a new tier whenever the gap to the next prospect exceeds tune.tierGap (per round). Then samples within the best available tier with mild bias toward the leader.
Tier boundaries use the prospect's continuous rookie_adp value (not the integer-spaced consensus_rank), so natural clusters are detected instead of bunching all top players into one tier.
tierBleed parameter — small chance the engine reaches one tier deeper than the current best (rare in R1, climbs to 30-40% by R5).
Validated with 500-iteration sim: 1.01 = Love 100%, 1.02 = Tate 100%, 1.03-1.06 = realistic spread among Tyson/Price/Lemon/Mendoza.

Trade modal: when /api/franchise-assets returns non-JSON (e.g. local python.http.server preview that doesn't host the worker), fall back to a local stub built from STATE.live (current-year picks) + STATE.future_picks (future picks). Player rosters still need the live worker; banner explains.
Removed gaussian jitter sigma — score variation now comes purely from owner position-mix bonus + offense/defense skew + tier sampling. Simpler, more transparent.

changes.summary: Fix critical bug: auto-draft engine was scoring unranked players as rank 0 (better than #1) because Number(null) === 0 in JavaScript, not NaN. LT Overton, Keyshawn James-Newby, and other UDFA DEs were beating Jeremiyah Love at 1.01.
details: Replaced Number.isFinite(Number(x)) checks with explicit null comparisons via _hasRank(v) helper.
Eligibility filter and score baseline both now treat null/undefined consensus_rank as 'no signal' (defaults to 999), not as rank 0.
Validated with 100-iteration sim: 100/100 picks at 1.01 are now Jeremiyah Love (was sometimes Overton/James-Newby/etc due to the bug).

changes.summary: Auto-draft engine tuned per round — Round 1 now always takes the consensus #1 (no jitter, no randomness). UDFAs and unranked players excluded from rounds 1-4. Step button respects 'Play as'.
details: Per-round tuning table: R1 σ=0.3 sample=1 (deterministic), R2 σ=1.0 sample=2, R3 σ=2.0 sample=3, R4 σ=2.5 sample=4, R5 σ=3.0 sample=5, R6 σ=4.0 sample=6.
R1 always returns the lowest-score prospect — at 1.01 you will see Jeremiyah Love every time. The 70/30 top-N sampling kicks in starting at R2.
Position-mix bonus capped: posMul scales 0 → 2.0 by round (was a flat 4.0 in v1.3.0). Side bonus (offense/defense skew) scales 0 → 1.0 (was a flat 1.5).
Eligibility filter: in rounds 1-4, players with NO ranking signal (consensus_rank null AND rookie_adp null) are excluded entirely. UDFAs like Noah Whittington can only enter the pool at R5+.
Step button now blocks when your franchise is on the clock — toasts a reminder instead of silently picking for you.

changes.summary: Auto-Draft engine — non-user franchises auto-pick on a 10s timer using consensus rank + owner tendencies + randomness. Pause / Resume / Step / Reset controls. Switch which franchise you 'play as' to simulate from any seat.
details: Algorithm per pick: score = consensus_rank + gauss_jitter(σ=2.5) − position_mix_bonus − offense/defense_side_bonus + reach_penalty (rounds 3+).
80% of the time the engine takes the lowest-score prospect; 20% it samples from the top-3 weighted by softmax — keeps simulations from being identical run-to-run.
Round 6 picks filtered to defense (UPS IDP-only rule).
Owner tendencies pulled from rookie_draft_team_tendencies.json: position_mix (e.g. 'WR 26% / RB 22% / QB 17%') and offense_pct shape who each owner gravitates to.
UI: new Auto-Draft card under On-the-Clock with Play-as dropdown (any franchise), speed selector (5s/10s/20s/Instant), and Start/Pause/Resume/Step/Reset buttons. Animated progress bar between picks.
When the playing franchise comes on the clock, the sim auto-pauses with a 'Your pick' banner. User can submit manually OR hit Resume to let the engine pick for them too.
Modal-aware: opening any modal (trade workbench, player profile, pick confirm) pauses the sim; closing resumes. Trades stay manual via the existing modal flow.
Reset button clears all simulated picks from local STATE — does NOT touch the worker / MFL.
All client-side: no /api calls, no Discord posts during auto-sim. The 'Submit Pick' modal during a sim records the pick locally so the sim continues.

changes.summary: Multi-source rookie ranking consensus — blends MFL ADP + FantasyCalc + KeepTradeCut (live-scraped) into a median consensus rank. Default sort and on-the-clock breakdown both surface the wisdom of crowds.
details: New script: pipelines/etl/scripts/fetch_external_adp.py — fetches FantasyCalc SF dynasty values, scrapes KeepTradeCut SF rookie rankings (replaces stale local config file), and pulls DynastyProcess weekly CSV. No API keys required. Writes site/rookies/external_adp_2026.json.
Fixed broken MFL filter: 'mfl_rookie_sf' was using IS_PPR=0 (non-PPR), not SuperFlex — dropped entirely; FantasyCalc and KTC now provide the SF signal instead.

build_prospects() now merges external_adp_2026.json by (a) MFL player_id where available and (b) name match in BOTH 'Last, First' and 'First Last' orderings (was only matching one direction, missed everyone).

New consensus_rank field per prospect = MEDIAN rank across all available sources (MFL rookie + FantasyCalc + KTC + DynastyProcess + MFL dynasty + MFL mock). Median, not mean — one outlier source can't drag the consensus.
Each prospect carries source_ranks, consensus_n_sources, consensus_rank_min, consensus_rank_max so owners see the spread.
UI: segmented control replaces 'Avg / MFL / KTC SF / ZAP' with 'Consensus / MFL / FC / KTC' — Consensus is the new default sort.
On-the-Clock card shows the consensus rank + per-source breakdown for the queued prospect (MFL #X · FC #Y · KTC #Z).
Footer attribution under the live tab lists every blended source + last-pulled date so owners know what they're trusting.
FantasyCalc 'mflId: UNK' literal handled correctly (was clobbering all 70 rookies into one entry).
Verified: Oscar Delp (R3.9 NOS) now reports consensus #42 across MFL #42 + FC #35 + KTC #44 — was previously showing only the MFL signal.

changes.summary: Refreshed prospect board with post-NFL-draft data; added age, college, NFL draft pick / UDFA flag, height, weight to every prospect; profile card now renders a rich pre-NFL block when career stats are empty.
details: Re-ran build_prospects() — pool grew from 105 to 258 (more rookies in MFL post-draft signing window) and every prospect now carries a current NFL team (was 'FA' for everyone in the v1.1.0 snapshot).

New fields per prospect: nfl_draft_round, nfl_draft_pick_in_round, nfl_draft_team, is_udfa, nfl_draft_summary ('R1.3 · ARI' or 'UDFA · DAL'), college, height, weight, age, birthdate_unix, espn_id, rotowire_id.
Prospect rows in the live tab show a green 'R1.3 · ARI' badge for drafted rookies and a slate 'UDFA · DAL' badge for undrafted free-agent signings, plus the college name + age inline.

Player profile card replaces the 'No career data yet' fallback with a Pre-NFL Prospect block showing draft summary / college / age / height / weight / UPS rookie ADP — only for current-year rookies. Veterans with no logged games still get the original message.

New script: pipelines/etl/scripts/refresh_prospects.py — slim wrapper around build_prospects() that writes to the in-repo path (the original build_rookie_draft_hub.py points at a stale /Users/keithcreelman/Documents/New project location).
NCAA stats explicitly skipped (Keith's call) — leaves room to wire CollegeFootballData later if the bio-only view turns out to be too thin.

changes.summary: Live Draft tab fully built out — owners can submit picks + propose trades from the hub, with default-ON simulate mode for risk-free rehearsal.
details: Replaced Live Draft 'Under Construction' placeholder with a modern 3-column UI: prospect rail (chips + segmented ADP control + general player search) · 6×12 draft board · sticky On-the-Clock card.
Sticky mode banner at top: SIMULATE (amber, default) vs LIVE (red, commissioner-only flip with confirm dialog). Mode persists across refreshes via sessionStorage.
Auto-login via MFL HPM context — when an owner views the hub from MFL's homepage, FRANCHISE_ID is detected from the iframe URL and used as 'who is acting' (no cookie paste).
Rookie contract preview in the Confirm Pick modal: Y1 AAV, 3yr TCV, length, taxi/IDP/option-year notes — computed per slot from league_context_v1.md A1.

New worker endpoints: /api/me, /api/settings, /api/pick, /api/trade, /api/franchise-assets, /api/players-search. Pick submission goes to MFL draftResults import; trade submission goes to MFL tradeProposal import.
Discord announcements: simulated picks → test channel 1089538054236160010 (with [SIM] prefix); LIVE picks → official channel 1498680803419357234.
General player search panel — searches the entire MFL player pool by name, opens the same rich profile card used by Front Office (bio, contract, game log).
Keyboard shortcuts: / focuses prospect search, Esc closes modals, ? opens help.
Reduced-motion respected; mobile/tablet collapses to stacked layout.

changes.summary: Align Best/Worst pick attribution with All-Play winning % (NET-based); fix metric-popup semantic lookup; add Slot Percentile; add versioning system.
details: Best Pick = highest 3yr NET (was: tier-ranked composite). NET correlates with AP% at +0.850; it's the authoritative 'impact on winning' metric.
Worst Pick = lowest 3yr NET (was: tier-ranked composite). Same reasoning.
Bang-for-$ = highest Draft Rating (was: raw points above slot-expected). Lavonte David now correctly surfaces as Keith Creelman's Bang-for-$ at 3.04 / +77.4 Draft Rating.
Cell-level popup definitions now resolve by per-cell semantic (not metric-wide). Clicking Slot-Exp NET shows Slot-Exp NET definition regardless of which view is active.
Added Slot Percentile field: 0-100 rank of pick's NET within its exact (round, slot) historical population. TRich 2012 1.01 = 0 (worst 1.01 ever). Zeke 2016 1.01 = 92.9.
Introduced VERSION.json + CHANGELOG.md versioning system with badge in hub header.
Games-weighted per-year rank averaging (was: simple average).
Tier popup + metric popup now lead with 'In plain English' block before technical definition.
Shrinkage explanation rewritten with plain-English first, technical second, plus concrete value interpretation.

changes.summary: Initial published version. Baseline methodology locked.
details: NET tier classifier: E+P − 0.5×Dud with thresholds 30/15/0
Games-weighted 3-year averaging for E+P, Dud, NET, Win Chunks, PPG ranks
Rostered-starter baselines for positional win-chunk calculations (uniform methodology 2011-2025)
Draft Rating with Bayesian shrinkage (20-pick pseudo-count) and 0-100 normalization
Future pick projection using 10yr owner-tracked AP% with bracket-aware playoff-Δ adjustments
Pre-2017 ownership inference via chronological replay of drafts + adds + drops + trades
Universal tier-click and metric-cell-click popups with plain-English explanations
